title: Semantic version ordering with pre-releases
prompt:
`Version` in src/lib.rs parses `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` but releases now carry pre-release tags (`1.0.0-alpha.1`,
`1.0.0-rc.2`). Make `Version::parse` accept an optional pre-release and implement `Ord` following the SemVer 2.0
precedence rules (a pre-release sorts before its release; dot-separated identifiers compare numerically when both
are numbers, lexically otherwise, numbers before text; a longer list wins when all earlier ones are equal).
Build metadata after `+` is ignored for ordering.
